name: Showrun
title: Showrun | Amplifier Smart Tools
promise: Show the experience. Keep the footage.
description: Turn an application walkthrough into a recording. Let your agent prepare the demo, then watch what happened and leave feedback beside the moment that needs work.
alt: Showrun review workspace with an Outtake recording, labeled recipe steps, and a note editor.
caption: The real Showrun review workspace, using fictional sample footage. A selected recipe step stays beside its feedback.
flow_title: From a prepared app to a reviewable take.
flow_intro: Your agent brings the purpose and starting material. Showrun operates the actual interface and retains the result.
steps: Supply a working application, sample data, ordered steps, and the outcomes you want to show. Choose which interactions the recording may perform.
Showrun observes the application, performs the permitted steps, and holds each result on screen. The recording runs separately from your browser tabs.
Play the footage or jump to a labeled step. Leave notes, keep the original MP4, or download a ZIP of the demo. Ask your agent for a new take when you are ready.
detail_title: A record you can return to.
details: Notes and drafts stay attached to the clip and section you are reviewing. Saving a note does not silently start another recording.
Retained takes include what happened, including incomplete steps and failed attempts. MP4 downloads preserve the original recording.
Watch, comment, organize, and download retained footage in the standalone dashboard or an optional MCP App.
prompt: Use Showrun to record a walkthrough of my prepared app. Read showrun --help, check the capture environment, and help me define the demo steps. Open the recording so I can review each step and leave notes.
prerequisites: Python 3.12+, Git, uv, Chromium, and FFmpeg with FFprobe and libx264. Follow the tool guide to prepare the capture environment.
model_note: Capture uses separately configured OpenAI or Anthropic access through Amplifier Agent. Review needs no model.
